# Xdatrys

> Xdatrys is an international travel and smartphone photography company that shows travelers where to go, where to stand and how to frame the shot, so great photos need no editing.

## Pocket Lens newsletter
- [All issues](https://xdatrys.com/issues/): every issue of the daily smartphone travel photography newsletter
- [Subscribe](https://xdatrys.com/subscribe/): the free newsletter, five issues a week
- [RSS feed](https://xdatrys.com/feed.xml): the newest issues

## Free shot maps
- [All shot maps](https://xdatrys.com/maps/): where to stand to photograph each place with a phone
- [Bergen, Norway: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/bergen/): Where to stand by the harbour in Bergen, Norway, to feature the rain and bring bright color into the frame. Free shot map of Bergen, Norway from Xdatrys.
- [Bora Bora, French Polynesia: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/bora-bora/): Where to stand on Motu Tapu in Bora Bora for the sunset crowd shot, and a taste of the full Pocket Scout guide.

- [Burj Khalifa, Dubai: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/burj-khalifa/): Burj Khalifa, Dubai photo spots: look up from Burj Park for a low angle by day, then frame the tower with palms at night. A free shot map from Xdatrys.
- [Caernarfon Castle, United Kingdom: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/caernarfon-castle/): Where to stand by the quay in Caernarfon, Wales, to photograph the castle. Free shot map of Caernarfon Castle, United Kingdom from Xdatrys.
